payload.gap_claim: Every alternative sheds the enforcement seam. Prompt-discipline harnesses (CLAUDE.md rules, contract prose, skills) shed mechanical guarantees - the model can and does drift, witnessed daily. Workflow engines and CI pipelines (GitHub Actions, Temporal-style orchestrators) enforce mechanically but shed the adjudication loop and the design-level drawing - nobody redlines a YAML in Obsidian, and no gate waits for a human bless as a first-class state. v1's own quack engine enforced walk laws but shed drawability: the process lived in Go code and rigor templates, so changing it was engineering, not drawing. The gap: a process engine whose SOURCE is the owner's drawing and whose ENFORCEMENT is tool-boundary refusals, with human gates native. Scan basis: v1 history, the harness ecosystem we run in daily, and the i2f/i2g groundwork - this iteration positions against the field as lived, a fresh state-of-the-art scan is the standing retro question.
payload.why_now: Three things matured together: (1) i2f/i2g made machines ledger data - canvas compiles at load, so the executor has a real spec to run; (2) a week of v2 dogfood produced a measured pain record (call log, notes inbox) instead of hunches - today's retro ranked the gaps; (3) the owner's rulings this morning fixed the last design unknowns: retro-first onboarding, one-brief kickoff, milestone-scoped testing, gate-bound commits, parallelism early. The design is decided; only the executor is missing.
payload.value_props: One-pager A - audience: the owner (solo engineer driving agents). Need: day-scale iterations that stay controlled unattended | outcome: the machine hands packets, gates block, offers surface; PASS: one full iteration (this one) runs kickoff-to-ship with every gate offered mechanically and zero contract-only rules violated. Need: speed through parallelism | outcome: two agents hold two active states of one iteration; PASS: demonstrated on one real parallel branch (e.g. log_risks beside the M1 spine) with both tokens visible side-by-side on the board. Need: a board that never lies about pace | outcome: 1s rule holds; PASS: no interactive call over 1s in the iteration's call log slice, suite runs return handles. One-pager B - audience: the driving agent (a fresh session). Need: never guess the process | outcome: every step arrives as a packet with guidance and evidence form; PASS: a cold session reaches the first gate with zero se_help misses on process questions. Need: recover from any refusal in one turn | outcome: every rejection carries a callable remedy; PASS: the i4 cold-model run proves one-turn recovery on each clause - deferred there explicitly.
payload.business_case: No acquirer exists - recorded reason: quackitect is the owner's method vehicle; the currency is the owner's working day. The effort buys: iterations that run while the owner is elsewhere, and a process that improves itself from its own log instead of from memory.
